messages.content: Write a correct Python function merge_intervals(intervals) that merges overlapping closed integer intervals and returns them sorted by start as a list of [start, end] lists. The input may be unsorted. Return only one fenced Python code block containing the function, no extra prose.

Write a correct Python function two_sum_sorted(numbers, target) that takes a list of integers sorted ascending and returns the two 0-based indices [i, j] with i < j such that numbers[i] + numbers[j] == target, using two pointers. Return only one fenced Python code block containing the function, no extra prose.

Convert this CSV to a JSON array of objects. Keep the column order and parse the commits column as integers.

linus,kernel,7

Reply with only the JSON, nothing else.
